messages:
Taylor Nguyen: Hi team — stuck on onboarding. I clicked the Okta link and it complains 'multiple accounts found' even though I only used my work email on the form. I tried signing out of Google, incognito, and a different browser. 1Password also says there's a seat but I can't accept it (gives me 'claimed by another user'). Any way to get temp Drive access and finish SSO?

Indira (IT): Welcome Taylor! This looks like a stale alias collision: sometimes contractors/stage accounts keep a shadow mapping and Google returns multiple principals. Can you confirm the exact email on your offer + any personal gmail addresses you might have used? Also do you have a security key or phone MFA only?

Taylor Nguyen: Offer shows taylor.nguyen@redwood.com. I also have taylor.n.dev@gmail.com which I occasionally use. Only phone MFA so far.

Indira (IT): Thanks. Two quick paths: 1) I can reprovision an Okta invite to taylor.nguyen+onboard@gmail.com to force the chooser away from your personal account, OR 2) I can remove the stale mapping and reassign the existing 1Password seat. Which do you prefer? I can also create a temporary shared Drive link to your personal email in the meantime.

Taylor Nguyen: Reassigning the seat would be nicer so I don't have to manage another alias. Temp Drive link is fine for now.

Onboarding Bot: Ticket #15022 created -> IT:accounts assigned to Indira. ETA ~3 hours.

Luis (People Ops): Taylor — I've flagged the 1Password seat (ticket #15024) for reassignment. Indira, can you confirm the group lookup for new-hires so seat sync works? Marta, please confirm manager approval for access.

Marta (Manager): Approved. Welcome Taylor! Grant view access to the "eng-onboarding" folder please.

Indira (IT): Quick update: I removed the stale contractor mapping and re-linked the 1Password seat to taylor.nguyen@redwood.com. Also forced a directory sync and shared a provisional Drive folder to taylor.n.dev@gmail.com (Viewer). If you still hit the Okta chooser, try clearing accounts cookie:
```
1) open chrome://settings/siteData
2) search "accounts.google.com"
3) remove entries and retry Okta link in incognito
```

Onboarding Bot: Ticket #15022 updated -> work in progress.

Taylor Nguyen: Got the Drive link and the 1Password invite arrived. Thanks! One more Q: once this is fully resolved, will my enrolled MFA methods persist or will I need to re-enroll? I plan to use a passkey + a YubiKey later.

Indira (IT): Your phone MFA will persist when we rebind the canonical account. For passkeys/hardware tokens you should re-enroll them under the canonical workspace identity to avoid orphaned credentials — hardware keys typically need a fresh registration. We recommend enrolling one platform passkey and one hardware key for redundancy. Docs in handbook -> IT/onboarding -> "SSO & MFA". If you want, I can schedule a quick 1:1 to walk through enrollment once the seat is confirmed. :thumbsup:

Taylor Nguyen: Great — schedule would be awesome. Thanks for the quick turnaround everyone!

Indira (IT): Scheduling a 15-min slot now. Ping me if anything else pops up. :wave:
